quality.ux.summary: All 7 Start work ActionCards clicked on /brief as admin, and each changed the URL to the governed destination. The whole card is clickable and keyboard Enter works with a visible focus ring. The Lineup cases approval chip is wired to ?approval=pending. Findings: at 390, Start work pushes Needs attention below the first viewport; the ScopeBar summary ignores the filter.

quality.rendered.summary: Rendered /brief and /lineup/cases at 1707x876 (window) and in same-origin iframes at exactly 1280x800 and 390x844. Cards show as a 4+3 grid at 1280 and one column of 351px at 390, with no horizontal overflow. The Lineup strip shows 5 live figures (7,309 / 96 / 100% / 1646 / 20%). Findings: Planned column header and cells are misaligned; Approval and actions sit off-screen at 1280 behind the grid's horizontal scroll.

quality.content.summary: AC2 fails. The steward-queue card reads 'Resolve unmatched tokens / Unmatched tokens from imports, resolved in one place.' (startWork.ts:62-68). That does not describe the N-0027 failure-type queue, reads as the legacy mapping queue, and 'in one place' contradicts the queue's job-steward routing. The previous copy 'Candidates grouped by failure type' was replaced in d25a9275. Also: header '2 703 lines' vs strip '1647 plan lines'; 'Approval 100%' rests on 1 decided line.

verification.rendered.summary: Real mouse clicks on each of the 7 cards, then location read: /admin/imports?unified=1, /lineup/cases, /promotions?propose=1, /admin/imports?template=customer_sell_through, /admin/imports?template=inbound_shipments, /admin/mappings (steward-failure-queue-strip present), /commercial-planner/cpor-cases. A click at 390 inside the iframe reached /lineup/cases. Window resize did not work, so an iframe viewport was used.

verification.referent.summary: The design-lab OverviewSurface mounts StartWorkLaunch (OverviewSurface.tsx:33,231), and the lab ActionCard re-exports the production workbench-ui ActionCard. /design-lab rendered identical card anatomy and metrics (344x122, rgb(34,38,46), 12px radius) and the same strip-above-dashboard/attention order. The planner role showed 3 cards, consistent with PLANNER_PLUS.

quality.design_divergence.summary: Production matches the lab composition: typography heading, no Panel/Card wrapper, ActionCard grid, strip above dashboard 1fr and attention. Divergences are data-driven only (tenant, live signals, live widgets); lab hrefs are intended analogs.

quality.design_signatures.summary: Signatures observed: ActionCard (uppercase eyebrow, bold title, 3-line-clamped caption, START chevron affordance, primary icon), HeadlineStrip/HeadlineFigure with warn-accent severity border, ScopeBar chips with Clear, DomainHeader crumbs + LensTabs, EnterpriseDataGrid with StatusChip.

quality.rendered_comparison.summary: Side-by-side of /design-lab (planner, 3 cards) and /brief (admin, 7 cards) at the same window: same card dimensions, fill, radius and anatomy; same subline copy.

quality.design_sameness_review.summary: The seven cards share one template, differentiated by eyebrow group and icon; that sameness suits a launch strip. Minor: the ActionCard docstring deliberately matches the Import Center tile surface; it is a distinct component with eyebrow and START, so not a type-picker reuse.

quality.design_state_coverage.summary: States observed: admin populated (7 cards); lab planner role-filtered (3 cards); hover (primary border/tint); keyboard focus-visible ring; Lineup loading ('—' before queries resolve) then populated; pending filter active (filled chip, URL param); 390 single-column. The viewer empty state was verified by unit test only, not rendered.

Only the admin role was rendered in production; steward, planner and viewer gating was verified from code and unit tests (the planner role was seen only in the design lab).
Role gating is client-visibility only; server-side enforcement on the destinations was not examined.
Reviewer was partly exposed to implementer changelog lines in root CONTEXT.md while grepping for D-0011; the verdict rests on independent code, tests and clicks.
